en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large mass gymnastics display in a stadium. The foreground features rows of boys in dark tops and light shorts or trousers performing synchronized calisthenics with arms raised, while the stands behind them are filled with spectators. The lower part of the card contains printed captions in Greek and French referencing the 1904 Panhellenic and school games in Athens, along with some handwritten script.
